operations.summary: List active challenge policies in one tenant scope
operations.description: Requires challenge_policies.read. Results use stable keyset ordering; the versioned HMAC-SHA256 cursor is opaque and must be replayed unchanged with the same authenticated actor, target scope, filters, limit, and sort. Invalid cursors return 400 before storage is read. Pages may contain fewer than the requested limit to stay within the default 256 KiB response byte budget; next_cursor resumes after the last emitted item. Soft-deleted policies are excluded. A tenant principal targeting another tenant receives the same 404 shape as an unknown scope.

params.name: cursor

It binds key ID, API audience, authenticated actor user/scope/kind, target scope, site/host/enabled filters, limit, fixed sort, and keyset position. Replay it byte-for-byte; wrong key, audience, version, key ID, scope, filter, limit, sort, semantic re-encoding, or an overlong value returns 400 before storage is read.

fields.description: Signed by the license service from the verified manifest entrypoint. platform resources (themes, rule data packs) are confirmed only under /v1/platform; tenant plugins only under their tenant scope.

fields.name: entrypoint_type
fields.description: Plugin type, the verified manifest entrypoint type signed by the license service next to resource_scope (theme and rule_pack are platform resources, external_https and ui_page tenant plugins). Clients link a confirmed theme to theme management and a rule_pack to rule packs; they never infer the type themselves.

fields.name: status
fields.type: string: pending_confirmation / authorized / installing / enabled / disabled / upgrade_failed_lkg_preserved / uninstalled

fields.name: authorization_status
fields.description: Platform authorization state reported by the license service. Omitted when the license service was not reachable. A locally enabled plugin whose authorization is disabled is paused by the platform. pending_confirmation marks a purchased market plugin waiting for this controller's administrator: confirm sends the confirmation to the license service and then installs it.

fields.name: paused_by
fields.description: Who paused a disabled authorization, from the signed license snapshot. installation is this controller's own pause (resume allowed); operator (license operator) and service (market delisting or security advisory) are platform pauses this controller cannot resume. Omitted otherwise, and a disabled authorization without it is treated as a platform pause.

fields.name: paused_reason
fields.description: The reason recorded with that pause.

fields.name: available_upgrade
fields.description: A newer version the platform already authorized for this installation; submit it to upgrade.

operations.summary: Replay the terminal deliveries of a time range
operations.description: Re-sends every original (non-replay) delivery of this subscription created in [from, to) with a matching status and event type, up to limit. Each replay has the single-delivery guarantees: same event ID, new delivery ID, audit, rate limit, and the database re-checks that the bound installation still holds the event permission and the site filter still selects the event. A per-delivery idempotency key is derived from Idempotency-Key, so retrying the call never replays a delivery twice. Events from before the subscription existed are never sent.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Original delivery created at or after this time.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Original delivery created before this time; at most 31 days after from.

fields.name: statuses
fields.description: Defaults to both terminal states; [dead_lettered] re-sends only failed deliveries.

fields.name: event_types
fields.type: array<string: io.cdnca.certificate.v1.expiry_reached / io.cdnca.certificate.v1.status_changed / io.cdnca.deployment.v1.status_changed / io.cdnca.node.v1.status_changed / io.cdnca.security.v1.incident_detected / io.cdnca.site.v1.updated / io.cdnca.usage.v1.threshold_reached / io.cdnca.webhook.v1.test>

responses.description: Replay batch outcome.

fields.name: remaining
fields.description: More matching deliveries exist, or a rate limit stopped the batch; retry with the same Idempotency-Key.
